alexcrichton opened PR #15162 from alexcrichton:more-pat-removal to bytecodealliance:main:

I added these in #15123 in the hope that github-actions created PRs would still run CI before a maintainer takes a look. Turns out with today's release PRs being created this was not the case and it did not work. Accept for now that clicking a button to run CI is probably the best we can do without a PAT, and removing the PAT entirely still seems like the best course of action.
